rules.frameworks: NHS Supply Chain framework names matching /\b(central venous catheter|intravenous (?:cannula|accessories)|needlefree connection|infusion pumps and administration sets|extension sets and lines)/i. NHSSC names a framework after its clinical category, so the name is the key; the CBU category field is far too broad to filter on.
rules.suppliers: Every supplier NHS Supply Chain names on the frameworks above, resolved to one name per company through the Hub's alias registry, and ordered by how many of this speciality's frameworks they appear on. That count is the only claim made. It is not a ranking of size or share. Where NHS Supply Chain spelled a company two ways across its own pages, both spellings are shown against the one entry.
rules.awards: Award-stage notices whose TITLE matches /\b(vascular access|picc\b|peripherally inserted central|midline catheter|central venous (?:catheter|access|line)|central line|intravenous|iv\b|cannulae?\b|cannulation|infusion pump|syringe driver|syringe pump|administration set|giving set|needle[- ]?free|venepunctur|venipunctur|phlebotom|port-?a-?cath|implantable port|totally implantable venous|tivad|hickman|groshong|broviac|arterial line|arterial catheter|extension set|catheter securement|opat\b|outpatient parenteral|infusion therapy)/i and does not match /\b(nasal cannula|\w+mab\b|fluids?\b|irrigation|insulin|glucose|erythropoietin|immunoglobulin|antibiotics?\b|\d+\s?m(?:g|l|cg)\b|vials?\b|concentrate for|powder for|solution for (?:infusion|injection)|pre-?filled)/i. The exclusion list exists because every pattern in it matched a real notice that was not this speciality. A CPV code beginning 33141220 or 331941 or 33141624 is recorded as corroboration where the feed carries one, but never admits a notice on its own: a notice carrying a basket of CPV codes is filed under all of them and bought under one. Buyer names are never matched on.
rules.openTenders: Notices still open for bidding, matched the same way. An empty list means no open notice on this patch today, not that none was looked for.
rules.drugTariff: No Drug Tariff part applies to this speciality. Part IX reimburses dressings and elastic hosiery (IXA), incontinence appliances (IXB), stoma appliances (IXC) and elastic hosiery (IXR); nothing on this patch is listed there, so the panel carries no tariff rather than reaching for the nearest part.
